newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Total Access mandates $200 mln revolver.
newsitem.headline: Total Access mandates $200 mln revolver.

text.p: Total Access Communication Plc has mandated Union Bank of Switzerland to arrange a US$200 million revolving credit facility, the arranger said on Friday.
The facility has a final maturity of 364 days. It pays a standby letter of credit facility fee of 0.375 percent per annum and a commitment fee of 0.175 percent.

Participation fees for co-arrangers committing US$15 million or more are 12.5 basis points for an all-in return of 50 basis points, 10 basis points for lead managers committing US$10-14.9 million for an all-in return of 47.5 basis points and 7.5 basis points for managers committing US$6-9.9 million for an all-in return of 45 basis points.
Proceeds are to be used for general working capital.
The borrower's long-term debt is rated BBB-minus by Standard and Poor's and Ba1 by Moody's Investors Services Inc.
The issue has been fully underwritten by UBS.
